content.description: ARQ, formerly known as DolarApp, is a Latin American consumer finance app that gives users in markets such as Mexico, Argentina, Brazil, and Colombia access to digital dollars and euros. It lets people convert local currency into the dollar-denominated stablecoin USDc and back within seconds, hold stable value against inflation, and spend through a card and international transfers. Users can top up and withdraw stablecoins over networks including Ethereum, Polygon, and Tron (USDT), making the app a bridge between everyday spending and stablecoin rails. Positioned for travelers, freelancers, and professionals across the Americas, ARQ combines a familiar neobank experience with stablecoin infrastructure to deliver cheaper, faster cross-border money movement.
